page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, full width, in Latin with Hebrew headwords and Hebrew phrases. Running head at top left and centre, page number at top right. No margins, no notes below the text.

main_text.p: Fœm. מַעְיָנוֹת Fontes, Jef.41.18. Constr. כָּל־מַעְיְנוֹת הַמַּיִם Omnes fontes abyssi, Genef.7.11. Aff. מַעְיְנֶיךָ Fontes tui, Proverb.5. v.16.
עִיף Fessum, Defessum, Lassum esse: Præter. עָיְפָה נַפְשִׁי Fessa fuit anima mea, Jer.4.31. Futurum anomalum, וַיֵּעַף Et fessus fuit, Jud.4.21. habet Kamets quasi ab עוף. Convenit cum עָיַף.
עָיֵף m. Fessus, Lassus, Genef.25.29. Plural. עֲיֵפִים Fessi, Jud.8.5. Fœmin. עֲיֵפָה Fessa: Et metaphoricè per Cata-chresin, Sitibunda, Prov.25.25.
עֵיפָה f. Vide supra in עוף.

עִיר f. Urbs, Civitas: Quidam ad עִיר referunt, quòd hominum actionibus & operis Excitata fit: Cum ה locali: הָעִירָה In civitatem, Gen.44.13. Aff. בְּעִירוֹ In civitate sua, Jud.8.27. עִירָם Civitatis eorum, Gen.34.20. Plur. עָרִים Urbes, Num.35.2. Constr. עָרֵי Num.32.36. Aff. עָרָיו Urbes ejus, Deut.2.34. עֲרֵיהֶם Urbes eorum, Numer.21.3. Aliam significationem vide infrà in עַר. Et alia forma, עֲיָרִים Urbes, Jud.10.4.

עִיר m. Pullus, proprie asini, Asellus, Zachar.9. v.9. וְעִיר פְּרָא Et pullus (&) onager, Job.11.12. Aff. עִירָהּ Pullum suum, Gen.49.11. cum ה loco Vau: Plural. עֲיָרִים Aselli, Jud.12.14. עַל כַּתֵּף עֲיָרִים Super humero asinorum, Jesa.30.6. scriptum cum ו, sed juxta Masorethas legendum עֲיָרִים.
עַכְבָּר m. Mus, Lev.11.29. Plur. Const. עַכְבְּרֵי זָהָב Mures auri, 1.Sam.6.4.
עַכְבִּישׁ m. Araneus, Job.8.14. וְקוּרֵי עַכְבִּישׁ Et telæ aranei, Jesa.59.5.
עַכְס m. Compes: וּכְעֶכֶס אֵל מוּסַר אִוִּיל Et ficut (vir) compedis ad eruditionem stultorum, Prov.7. v.22.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are only approximately as printed; the headwords and phrases were read from a small scan and pointing marks may be off. Greek and Hebrew are transcribed in Hebrew letters. The running head was read as the two Hebrew catchwords at top left and centre. No catchword or signature at the foot.
